verdict.rationale: Brex's own product pages describe built-in AI agents that take on tasks inside the product. AI assistants write expense memos, fetch receipts, offer policy help and file reimbursements; review and audit agents auto-approve, escalate and flag violations; and Brex AI drafts bill payments with suggested PO matches. The MCP server is an external integration for third-party assistants, so it is not credited here as a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: evidence of open-ended, user-initiated delegation (e.g. a conversational assistant accepting arbitrary requests), in-depth first-party docs beyond marketing claims, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
